g.text: Square shoulder + rigid toe; relaxed locked beam.

g.text: Stop is part of CLASP, so it cannot trap the whole clasp.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: Two separately enclosed keyholes. Front collar catches lid;

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: rear T-head catches base. No pin / spring / assembly gate.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: A lock: reverse toe-out → peel → press; seat lower toe,

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: press pad while pivoting hook behind lid shoulder; relax.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: A unlock: press ~0.90, peel upper end ~5°, move down

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: 3 mm to disengage toe, withdraw normal to keepers (+X).

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: Beam L24 × W8; thickness 1.6→1.2; exact R1.4 root.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: E0.60 hook overlap ≠ fit G0.80. Self-stop at ~1.20 travel.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: Orange PRESS/PEEL is approximate motion, not FEA.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: Never pry the hook or force it past its stop.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: B lock: align head parallel to seam X; insert through BOTH.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: At full push rotate 90°, then pull outward into rear pocket.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: B unlock: push inward ~1.20 to unpark, counter-turn 90°,

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: withdraw. Do not rotate while seated in pocket.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: Bore 6.457 = neck diagonal + G; head sweep 19.239 mm.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247

g.text: Pocket 0.80 deep; unparked head rear gap 0.40.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #193247
